Our Mission

To support healthcare providers in optimizing their revenue, operations, and compliance.

Founded with a vision to simplify healthcare administration, PMEX brings years of industry expertise to the table. We understand the unique challenges faced by healthcare professionals and strive to provide tailored solutions that address these complexities.

Our team of seasoned professionals is committed to delivering exceptional service and driving your practice towards sustained growth and excellence. We believe in building lasting relationships, and we work tirelessly to ensure your success.

Dedicated to Every Specialty

We do not use a one-size-fits-all approach. Our certified billers are specialty-matched to your practice, with deep knowledge of the CPT codes, payer rules, and documentation requirements unique to your discipline.

Transparency in Everything We Do

We prioritize transparency and accuracy in financial reporting. The PMEX Portal gives every client a real-time view of their billing operations, updated by our team around the clock. No surprises.

Compliance as a Foundation

Full HIPAA compliance across every workflow. All data encrypted in transit and at rest. Every action audit-logged. We treat compliance not as a checkbox but as the foundation of everything we build.

Who We Are

Practice Management Experts.
1,200+ certified billing professionals.

AAPC-Certified Coders

Every coder on the PMEX team holds AAPC or AHIMA certification. Specialty-specific coding across CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS for all 67 specialties we serve.

Billing Specialists

Dedicated billing experts matched to your specialty. From charge entry to denial appeals, every step of your revenue cycle is handled by someone who knows your billing inside and out.

Credentialing Experts

Provider enrollment, CAQH maintenance, payer network setup, and ongoing revalidation managed by credentialing specialists who know payer timelines and requirements.

Account Managers

Every PMEX client has a dedicated account manager. A single point of contact who knows your practice, tracks your performance, and surfaces issues before they become problems.

The PMEX Portal

Real-time visibility into your billing operations. Updated by your team. Always on.

Every PMEX engagement includes access to the PMEX Portal, a live reporting dashboard updated by your dedicated billing team around the clock. See collections, claims, denials, A/R aging, and payer performance in real time. No integration. No setup. Log in and see everything.

Our Values

The principles that guide every
claim we touch

Accuracy First

Every claim scrubbed, every code verified, every modifier checked before submission. A 99% clean claim rate is the result of doing it right every single time.

Transparency

No black boxes. The PMEX Portal gives every client a live view of their billing operations. You always know what is happening with your revenue.

Partnership

We are not a vendor. We are a billing partner. We understand your specialty, know your payer mix, and work toward your financial goals the same way your own team would.

Compliance

HIPAA compliance, active data encryption, full audit trails. Compliance is not an afterthought at PMEX. It is built into every workflow from the ground up.
